parts.answer: For normal renal function (eGFR >=90), the starting dose is 50 mg OD with a maximum of 100 mg/day and routine monitoring. For mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89), the starting dose is 50 mg OD with a maximum of 100 mg/day and routine monitoring. For moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the starting dose is 25 mg OD with a maximum of 50 mg/day, and monitoring requires Recheck 2-4 weeks. For severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29), the starting dose is specialist review with a maximum of 25 mg/day and enhanced monitoring.
